themes.title: Far-Right Momentum and Electoral Contestation Ahead of Major Votes
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe are leveraging strong polling figures and local election victories to build momentum ahead of regional and national contests. From Vox in Spain and the AfD in Germany to France's Rassemblement National and Reform UK, right-wing coalitions are asserting themselves as viable governing alternatives while challenging establishment incumbents.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Campaigns heavily for the 29N election as polling shows a combined PP-Vox bloc reaching an absolute majority.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Surges to 28% in Politbarometer polling to widen its lead over the CDU/CSU while nominating a candidate for federal president.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen holds a double-digit poll lead for the 2027 presidential election amid ongoing campaign mobilization.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Wins multiple local council by-elections across former Labour heartlands, consolidating grassroots gains.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Navigates coalition and election strategy tensions as former PM Morawiecki announces an independent presidential run.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Posts high polling numbers in municipal surveys as Sylvi Listhaug positions the party for governing leadership.

themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Right-wing movements across the UK, France, Spain, and Germany continue to prioritize hardline border controls and opposition to asylum seeker placements. Framing mass migration as a core threat to public safety and national identity, these parties are pressing governments for immediate policy restrictions.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Clashes with Labour over emergency measures placing over 1,000 asylum seekers in local communities.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen demands strict limits on foreign immigration and rejects integration of hostile cultural elements.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Focuses campaign messaging on urban safety, neighborhood identity, and strict border enforcement.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Internal party debates intensify over explicit 'remigration' platform demands.

themes.title: Anti-Establishment Hostility to Public Media and Information Control
themes.blurb: Right-wing leaders in Poland, Spain, the UK, and Hungary are mounting attacks against public broadcasters and digital content regulation. By framing institutional moderation as state-sponsored censorship, right-wing figures seek to bypass mainstream channels and safeguard independent digital messaging.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: President Nawrocki vetoes the Digital Services Act implementation, framing content moderation as online censorship.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Santiago Abascal and Vox file electoral complaints against state broadcaster RTVE over alleged media bias.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Alleges targeted censorship and silencing by platforms despite free speech protections.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Clashes focus on state media access, secret service archive transparency, and digital coverage control.

themes.title: Judicial Crackdowns and Surveillance Targeting the Far-Right
themes.blurb: Right-wing factions in Brazil, France, and Germany report mounting legal pressure from judicial bodies and regulatory authorities. Party figures frame court rulings, investigative leaks, and potential bans as politically driven attempts to suppress populist movements.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: The Prosecutor General rejects Jair Bolsonaro's sentence review appeal while Flávio Bolsonaro challenges judicial passport restrictions.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Jordan Bardella files legal actions over leaked antisemitic writings while pursuing defamation suits against political opponents.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Faces renewed constitutional debate over potential party prohibition and state surveillance of extremist ties.

themes.title: Transnational Right-Wing Networking and Parallel Diplomacy
themes.blurb: Prominent right-wing leaders in Italy, Hungary, and Argentina are conducting independent diplomatic outreach and international summitry. By engaging directly on European defense, trade partnerships, and foreign policy, these figures aim to enhance their international stature outside conventional diplomatic channels.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni conducts bilateral air defense and security talks with Ukrainian President Zelensky in Dublin.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Opposition leader Péter Magyar holds talks with Zelensky in Dublin and arranges additional diplomatic meetings.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: President Javier Milei pursues strategic regional alliance talks with Paraguay and conducts papal diplomacy.
